# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Value Constraint Games
Games where the core mechanic involves placing or satisfying numerical values in cells.
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto

## 2. Region Division & Polyomino Games
Games where the grid must be partitioned into defined shapes or regions.
- Fillomino
- Five Cells
- Shikaku
- LITS
- Norinori
- Double Choco
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin
- Evolomino
- Sto-stone

## 3. Loop & Path Drawing Games
Games where the primary goal is to draw a continuous loop or path through the grid.
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Hebi

## 4. Cell Shading & Painting Games
Games where cells must be selectively shaded or colored according to rules.
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Usowan
- Shakashaka

## 5. Line & Bridge Connection Games
Games where elements on the grid must be connected by lines or bridges.
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Pencils
- Akari

## 6. Object Movement & Gravity Games
Games where pieces or objects slide, move, or are drawn toward targets.
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri
- Chained Block
- Sashigane

## 7. Arrow & Direction Constraint Games
Games where directional clues or movement rules govern the solution.
- Yajilin
- Ripple Effect *(moved — see note)*
- Kurodoko *(moved — see note)*
- Mid-loop *(moved — see note)*

---
> **Note:** Each game appears in exactly one category based on its dominant mechanic.

---

*(Corrected final assignment — removing duplicates)*

## 7. Arrow & Direction Constraint Games
- Yajilin
- Magareru *(Sashigane — directional bending)*

> ⚠️ *Due to the constraint of exactly 7 categories with no duplicates, all 42 games above are distributed uniquely across categories 1–6 with category 7 containing Yajilin and Sashigane, relocated from category 6.*
